title: Materials Administrator
description:
Material Administrator

This role will focus on SAP material management, inventory control, equipment tracking, and logistics coordination to ensure materials are available when required.

Desirable

title: Stores & Logistics Coordinator
description:
Stores & Logistics Coordinator

Location: Aberdeen
Salary: £28,000 £34,000 DOE
Hours: 37.5 hours per week Monday to Thursday, 8 hours per day; Friday, 5.5 hours
Contract: Permanent

An established engineering organisation supporting the offshore energy sector is looking to appoint an experienced Stores & Logistics Coordinator to join its operations team in Aberdeen.

This is a varied, hands-on position combining stores, materials control, procurement, logistics and administration. The successful candidate will play an important role in ensuring project materials and equipment are correctly identified, ordered, received, controlled and prepared for mobilisation.

The Role

Working closely with engineers, technicians, suppliers and logistics providers, the Stores & Logistics Coordinator will be responsible for the efficient movement and control of materials and equipment from procurement through to receipt, storage and dispatch.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Managing inventory, stock locations and equipment movements using an ERP system
- Raising purchase requisitions and placing purchase orders for project and workshop requirements
- Obtaining and negotiating supplier quotations to support best value
- Monitoring and expediting orders through to delivery
- Receiving and issuing stock and maintaining accurate system records
- Carrying out goods-in checks against purchase requirements
- Preparing and issuing project material kits
- Packing and unpacking equipment for offshore mobilisation and return
- Preparing shipping documentation, including delivery paperwork and Certificates of Conformity
- Coordinating the on-hire and off-hire of rental equipment
- Preparing materials and documentation for import/export shipments
- Liaising with freight forwarders, transport providers and suppliers
- Supporting asset management and stock reporting requirements
- Maintaining safe storage practices, including the handling of controlled materials
- Ensuring stores and logistics activities are completed in accordance with relevant quality, environmental and health & safety procedures

The Candidate

The successful candidate will ideally have previous stores, materials or logistics experience within an engineering, offshore, oil & gas or similarly technical environment.

They should also demonstrate:
- Previous experience within stores or warehouse operations
- Knowledge of import/export processes and shipping documentation
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
- Confidence using ERP or stock-management systems
- Good Microsoft Excel and Word skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a wider operations team
- A flexible, practical approach and willingness to learn
- A valid UK driving licence
- A forklift truck licence

What s on Offer

The position offers a salary of approximately £28,000 £34,000 depending on experience, alongside a 37.5-hour working week with an early finish on Friday.

This would suit an organised and proactive Stores or Logistics professional looking for a broad role where they can take ownership of materials, purchasing, stock control and shipping activities within a busy technical environment.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Your new company

Hays are delighted to be supporting a respected organisation in the Highlands with the recruitment of a temporary Executive Assistant to join their team on an initial 3-month assignment, which may have the potential to extend. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Executive Assistant or senior administrator to provide essential support to senior leaders within a fast-paced and professional environment. Working on a hybrid basis from Inverness, you will join a busy and collaborative team, playing a key role in ensuring the smooth coordination of executive and governance activities during a particularly busy period.

Your new role

As Executive Assistant, you will provide comprehensive administrative and organisational support to senior stakeholders and the wider Executive Office function. You will be responsible for managing complex diaries, coordinating meetings and ensuring the effective handling of correspondence and enquiries. Your ability to anticipate priorities, manage competing demands and maintain confidentiality will be essential to success in the role. You will support the coordination of briefing materials, agendas and meeting documentation for senior leadership meetings, boards and committees, ensuring that information is prepared accurately and distributed within agreed timescales. The role will also involve monitoring shared and executive mailboxes, tracking actions and deadlines, maintaining records and supporting governance-related administration.Acting as a professional point of contact on behalf of the Executive Office, you will work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure the smooth delivery of executive support services whilst helping to maintain continuity during a period of increased workload.

What you'll need to succeed

To be successful in this role, you will have previous experience providing high-level executive, senior leadership or governance support within a complex organisation. You will demonstrate exceptional diary management, meeting coordination and administrative skills, alongside experience managing busy inboxes and handling confidential information with discretion. You will possess strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks and deadlines effectively. Experience supporting boards, committees, leadership teams or governance functions would be highly advantageous. You will be a confident communicator with excellent attention to detail and strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel and SharePoint. Candidates with previous experience within the public sector or similarly regulated environments will be particularly well suited to this opportunity. Ideally, ou will live within a commutable distance to Inverness as this role will involve hybrid working in the office. You will also be required to go through a Disclosure Scotland application.
What you'll get in return

In return, you will secure a rewarding temporary assignment within a highly professional environment, gaining exposure to senior leadership teams and executive-level operations. The role offers a competitive hourly rate of pay, hybrid working, a supportive team environment and the opportunity to make an immediate impact within an established organisation. This role may also be extended beyond the original 3-month period.

title: Document Controller
description:
Overview:

We are recruiting for an experienced Document Controller or Senior Document Controller to work for a leading main contractor on a major infrastructure project based in Peterhead, Aberdeenshire. The Document Controller will support the project delivery team throughout the project lifecycle, taking responsibility for document management, information flow, reporting and maintaining electronic document management systems.

The successful Document Controller will work closely with engineering, commercial and site teams, subcontractors, suppliers and client representatives to ensure project information is accurate, controlled and issued on time. For the Senior Document Controller opportunity, there will be additional responsibility for leading document control processes, supporting the wider team and helping to develop best practice. This is a strong opportunity for long-term career progression within major infrastructure and energy projects.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Document Controller, you will:
- Manage and control the flow of project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
- Maintain document registers, electronic document management systems and project filing structures.
- Control document numbering, revisions, status, formatting and issue processes.
- Ensure the latest approved documentation is available to the relevant project teams.
- Manage technical, engineering, vendor, subcontractor, commercial and client documentation.
- Check documentation for accuracy and compliance before issue.
- Prepare and manage document transmittals and distribution of project information.
- Monitor review and approval cycles, proactively chasing outstanding documentation.
- Produce regular and ad-hoc document control and project status reports.
- Liaise with project teams, subcontractors, suppliers, consultants and client representatives.
- Support project personnel with document control processes and best practice.

As a Senior Document Controller, you will also take ownership of document control processes, provide guidance to project teams and support the training and development of other Document Controllers and project personnel.

Qualifications:
- Previous experience as a Document Controller, Senior Document Controller or in a similar project-based document management role.
- Experience within construction, engineering, energy, utilities or oil & gas infrastructure is highly desirable.
- Minimum 2 years' relevant experience for a Document Controller; greater experience expected for a Senior Document Controller.
- Strong knowledge of document control processes and project documentation.
- Experience using EDMS/CDE platforms such as Aconex, SharePoint, Viewpoint, ProjectWise or similar.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Confident communicating with stakeholders at all levels, with a proactive approach to chasing and expediting information.
- Experience working for a main contractor on a major infrastructure project would be advantageous.

Benefits:
- Long-term career progression within major infrastructure and energy projects.
- Opportunity to work for a leading main contractor on a major site-based project.
- Company pension.
- Ongoing professional development and training.

Ready to progress your career as a Document Controller or Senior Document Controller? Apply today to join a major infrastructure project offering excellent long-term career opportunities.

title: Contract Cost Administrator
description:
Contract Cost Administrator

Location: Dingwall
Working Pattern: Full-time, office-based

We are currently supporting the recruitment of a Contract Cost Administrator to join a busy team based in Dingwall. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail-focused individual with experience in cost administration, finance, or a similar support role to join a growing business operating within the construction sector.

Reporting to the Accounts Manager, the successful candidate will provide essential support to both the commercial and finance teams by managing project costs, processing supplier invoices, maintaining accurate records, and assisting with financial reporting.

Key Responsibilities:
- Processing, logging, and verifying supplier invoices within the cost management system.
- Matching invoices against purchase orders (POs) and relevant cost codes.
- Investigating and resolving invoice queries, liaising with suppliers, project teams, and internal stakeholders.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date records of project costs and supporting documentation.
- Reviewing and processing site documentation, including timesheets and delivery tickets (Goods Received Notes).
- Supporting commercial reporting activities, including plant trackers, contract valuations, and cost forecasting.
- Assisting with general cost control and administration activities to support project delivery.

About You:

The ideal candidate will have previous experience in a cost administration, accounting, finance, or assistant role, ideally within the construction, engineering, or a similar project-based environment.

You will have:
- Strong attention to detail with excellent accuracy in data entry and financial administration.
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including data manipulation and reporting.
- Experience using ERP systems or cost management software (desirable).
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to liaise with suppliers, site teams, and management.
- A structured and methodical approach to maintaining records and supporting processes.
- A background in accounting, finance, business administration, or bookkeeping would be advantageous.

If you are looking for your next opportunity within cost administration and have the skills and experience outlined above, we would welcome the opportunity to discuss this role with you.
